entities.summary: Manuel Payno was a Mexican writer, journalist, politician and diplomat. His political ideology was moderate liberal. Payno's most notable literature work include Los bandidos de Río Frío, a costumbrista novel deemed an iconic piece of Mexican literature that has been an inspiration source for other writers and artists, and also from which several film adaptations have been made.
